mapper.sql: SELECT id, principal_id, action, operation_id, normalization_version, input_digest, scope_digest, state, task_id, result_ref, error_code FROM sys_operation

SELECT id, user_id, task_type, input_digest, CAST(input_json AS CHAR) AS input_json, authorization_version, state, owner, execution_epoch, lease_until, attempt, max_attempts, deadline, available_at, result_ref, error_code, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_task
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_operation_control WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
WHERE (state IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task WHERE state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task WHERE user_id = #{user} AND state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_operation(id, principal_type, principal_id, action, operation_id, normalization_version, input_digest, scope_digest, state, task_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{principalType}, #{user}, #{action}, #{operation}, 1, #{digest}, #{scope}, 'PENDING', #{id})

INSERT INTO sys_task(id, user_id, task_type, input_digest, input_json, authorization_version, state, max_attempts, deadline) VALUES (#{id}, #{user}, #{type}, #{digest}, #{input}, #{version}, 'QUEUED', #{attempts}, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{budget}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_task SET state = 'RUNNING', owner = #{owner}, execution_epoch = execution_epoch + 1, attempt = attempt + 1, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{seconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_epoch = #{epoch}

UPDATE sys_task SET state = 'SUCCESS', result_ref = #{result}, error_code = NULL, owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND execution_epoch = #{epoch} AND owner = #{owner}
UPDATE sys_operation SET state = 'SUCCEEDED', result_ref = #{result}, error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id = #{id} AND state = 'PENDING'

UPDATE sys_task SET state = #{state}, error_code = #{code}, owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, available_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delay}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_epoch = #{epoch}
UPDATE sys_operation SET state = #{state}, error_code = #{code}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id = #{id} AND state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE sys_task SET state = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'QUEUED' AND attempt = 0

UPDATE sys_task SET state = 'QUEUED', attempt = 0, error_code = NULL, owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), deadline = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{budget}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND state IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_task_progress(task_id, execution_epoch, processed, phase) VALUES (#{id}, #{epoch}, #{processed}, #{phase}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE processed = IF(execution_epoch <= #{epoch}, #{processed}, processed), phase = IF(execution_epoch <= #{epoch}, #{phase}, phase), execution_epoch = GREATEST(execution_epoch, #{epoch}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
